filesystem.description: Read, write, and manage local files and directories — file reads, writes, renames, deletions, search, and directory listings.

github.description: GitHub API integration — search repos, read issues/PRs, check CI, create releases, and manage repos.

context7.description: Version-accurate library/framework docs (anti-hallucination) — resolve library ids and fetch current API signatures, config, and migration guidance. Pairs with the always-on library-docs rule. 2026 baseline MCP.

tavily.description: Web search for up-to-date information — documentation, news, tutorials, and technical answers.

hostinger-dns.description: Hostinger DNS management — create, update, and delete DNS records for domains.

hostinger-hosting.description: Hostinger web hosting management — manage hosting plans, websites, and server resources.

hostinger-vps.description: Hostinger VPS management — create, manage, and monitor virtual private servers.

hostinger-domains.description: Hostinger domain management — search, register, transfer, and manage domain names.

sequential-thinking.description: Multi-step reasoning for complex planning — break down problems, evaluate approaches, and document trade-offs.

stripe.description: Stripe payment processing — create products, prices, checkout sessions, manage subscriptions, and query payment data.

env.STRIPE_API_KEY: sk if using server mode; pk if using client mode

firebase.description: Firebase project management — authentication, Firestore, storage, hosting, and analytics configuration.

fetch.description: HTTP fetch tool — retrieve content from URLs for documentation, APIs, and web resources.

playwright.description: Slot 1 — localhost dev automation (Playwright Chrome, :3000/:3001). Isolated browser, not Brave profile.

playwright-brave.description: Slot 3 — real Brave/Chrome tab via Playwright MCP Bridge extension + --extension. Share tab when agent connects.

pilot.description: Slot 4 experimental — pilot-mcp + Pilot extension. pilot_tabs, handoff/resume, lean snapshots. PILOT_PROFILE=standard|core|full.

desktop-commander.description: Desktop command execution — run terminal commands, manage processes, and control the development environment.

comfyui.description: Local ComfyUI control plane (comfyui-mcp via npx) — workflow execution, model/node management on :8188. JonBeatz / local-GPU profiles only; disabled by default on bootstrap. Requires ComfyUI running (npm run comfy:start). Not Comfy Cloud.
